_about: Anthony R. Montalba's Fairy Tales from All Nations (London, 1849), with Richard Doyle's illustrations (not in the text): tales from many countries set in his English. The Gutenberg catalogue gives no dates for Montalba; a book he put out in 1849 cannot be in anyone's copyright now. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-10: Adam asked the project to keep going until he stops it; Adam may veto).
